notablePrerequisites: You control six or more creatures.
easyPrerequisites: Brigid and Formidable Speaker don't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding {W} for each other creature you control
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Halo Fountain.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, untapping Brigid and untapping Formidable Speaker, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Halo Fountain.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Formidable Speaker, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
If you have at least {1}{W} available, repeat from step 4 until you don't have {1}{W} available.
Repeat.

uses.name: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind
